text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 18px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: GPU resource summary across batch sizes
Points: mean of five trial summaries; error bars: sample SD. Ordinary decode: full background batch, output positions 32–80, no prefill.
Event resource averages are weighted by GPU step duration across all prefill chunks. Whole-output TPOT averages 127 token gaps per request.
B=10 Append: repeat 1 contains a 35 ms inter-kernel gap; retained in the mean and SD. See README for details.
